description: Model-authored lessons excluded, under MaxAge 90 days. Each candidate is excluded by the first rule that applies, in .NET's order: a model-authored Candidate is IneligibleStatus; a model-authored record, expired or not, is ModelAuthored; an expired deterministic one is Expired. A record whose producer is the library's own model-backed reflector counts as model-authored whatever authorship it declares. The exclusions are listed in the store's order.
